data.one_liner: Dynamically change the status bar color based on the background or current route.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package for dynamically changing the status bar color based on the background. It works with static colors and images, and can automatically update when the current route changes using a navigator observer.
use_when: You need the status bar color to automatically adapt to background colors or images.
You want automatic status bar updates on route changes via navigator observers.
avoid_when: You only need a static, globally fixed status bar color configured once in your app theme.
You do not use standard Navigator routing.
strengths: Supports automatic status bar updates on route changes.
Works with both static colors and images.
Allows manual refresh and direct setting of light/dark status bars.
data.setup_notes: Place StatusbarzCapturer above your MaterialApp and optionally add Statusbarz.instance.observer to navigatorObservers.
